A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).
